packet-01.zh: 如果成真，这条假设意味着双相障碍与精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者在「右侧 ROI312 与显著性/腹侧注意网络」这一指标上存在稳定的同方向降低——对脑研究，它把不同诊断连接到同一个可检验的网络机制上；对临床，这类可复现的连接指标有望成为辅助分型或追踪疗效的候选线索。
packet-01.en: If confirmed, this hypothesis would mean a stable, same-direction decrease in "Right ROI312 and the salience/ventral attention network" for people with bipolar disorder and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder. For brain research, it ties different diagnoses to one testable network mechanism; clinically, such a reproducible connectivity measure is a candidate lead for subtyping and for tracking treatment response.

packet-31.zh: 若后续研究确认，这条命题意味着ADHD 与精神分裂症/分裂情感性障碍患者在「边缘网络与感觉运动网络」上存在共同降低；本次不一致结果目前主要帮助界定该跨诊断命题的适用边界，不能作为已验证标志物。
packet-31.en: If later confirmed, this claim would imply a shared decrease in "Limbic and somatomotor networks" among people with ADHD and schizophrenia/schizoaffective disorder. The present inconsistent result instead helps define the boundary of the transdiagnostic claim and is not a validated biomarker.
